title: Bittopia 2023: the coding arcade
excerpt: Xtreme.Pera-23 brought IEEEXtreme to campus — teams kicked off at 5:30 a.m. Sri Lanka time, in step with the global start.
content:
Bittopia, the coding arcade under the programme Xtreme.Pera-23 — IEEEXtreme at the University of Peradeniya — commenced at 05:30 AM Sri Lankan time at the Faculty of Engineering, going along with the global competition starting at 00:00 UTC.

Seven teams participated in person and three additional teams joined remotely for the 24-hour competition.
